title: Documentation handoff
summary: [00:00-00:42] Guide review — Participant A opens the account-setup guide review ahead of the support handoff; Participant C flags an outdated screenshot and changed button label, including the need to confirm that the training account matches the released product • [00:42-01:13] Guide structure — Participant A proposes the normal setup sequence followed by troubleshooting and a contents list; Participant B agrees • [01:13-01:47] Support input — Participant B will contribute common support questions and check contact routes for staff and external accounts • [01:47-02:25] Draft & review — Participant A will coordinate revisions and produce a new draft Thursday afternoon for Participant B to review Friday morning • [02:25-02:55] Screen details & glossary — Participant C will confirm the screen details and prepare a glossary • [02:55-03:20] Internal trial — Participant A confirms that the first internal trial will use a structured text document • [03:20-04:02] Publication clarification — Participant B asks about translation and public publication; Participant A confirms that neither has been scheduled, and Participant C clarifies that the Friday date in the tracker refers to the glossary rather than a translated guide
